_comment: Two Strava segments are tracked: the 3.36 km bike segment (RAW) and the
4.29 km run segment (RUN). dist_km/gain_m are the SEGMENT's own numbers, not
the full 4.25 km climb the page presents — index.html rescales RAW by 4.24/3.36.
Both were reverse-engineered from the existing rows (vam*secs/3600 and
speed*secs/3600 are constant across all 407 / 200 efforts) and cross-checked
segment_id: fill in the Strava segment ids once known — they make matching exact
and let --no-geofence work. Until then matching falls back to segment_name, then
